[[Bartholos' Bulwark]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[shield]] obtained from [[Grahame]] in [[Lion's Arch Keep]] after completion of [[The Battle for Lion's Arch]] in exchange for 10 [[Medal of Honor|Medals of Honor]]. As the name would suggest, this shield is a replica of the one [[Bartholos]] wields.

==Stats==
:[[Armor]]: 16 (Requires 9 [[Strength]])
:Received [[physical damage]] -5 (Chance: 20%)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
It has the same skin as an undyed [[Bladed Shield]].

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, exact technical replicas for this item are:
*[[Bronze Shield]] from crafters [[Gertrud]], [[Honglei Sun]], [[Manzo]], [[Mathilde]], [[Telamon]], or [[Theodosus]]
*[[Shield of the Lion]] from collector [[Kwesi]] or crafters [[Aksah]], [[Asiri]], [[Hahbe]], or [[Kol Swordshanks]]
*[[Wooden Buckler]] from collector [[Maddison]]
